sections.title: Habit and cultivation
sections.text: Chickpea is an annual domesticated in the Fertile Crescent and now grown worldwide. Plants commonly reach about 20–100 cm; the taproot can extend 1–2 m. Its small papilionaceous flowers are about 8–10 mm long and pods usually contain one to three seeds.

sections.title: Seeds and plate
sections.text: Mature seeds are the chickpeas eaten as food; their size and colour vary among cultivated groups, including kabuli and desi. The plate matches the compound leaves, flowers and pods; the open pod with two seeds is one example, not a fixed count.
